verdict.rationale: llamafile documents its own server mode with HTTP server and API options, and calls itself 'the model, runtime, and server in one file', so it could plausibly act as a local LLM backend. The pack never shows a coding agent actually connected to it, and never documents API compatibility. missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible or other agent-consumable API endpoints, any guide or example connecting a coding agent, tool/function-calling support, hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
llamafile is the model, runtime, and server in one file.
